Judge whether the copy matches the brand voice.
Voice guidelines: ['Write plainly and specifically; name the feature and what it does.', "Lead with the customer's trip, not the product's ego.", 'Prefer concrete numbers (weight, capacity, ratings) over adjectives.', "Respect the reader's experience; assume they know the outdoors.", 'Be honest about limits — say what the gear is not built for.', 'One clear call to action per message.']

Subject: Ridgeline 2P is back — limited units, restocking now
Preview: A small shipment of the Ridgeline 2P is arriving. If your summer trip needs a tent, now's the time.
Body: A limited restock of the Northbay Ridgeline 2P (NB-TNT-02) is arriving — quantity is small, and once it's gone, availability is uncertain.

If you have a 3-season trip on the calendar — backpacking, car camping in shoulder conditions, or a summer ridge route — this tent is built for that work.

The details that matter for planning:

• 2-person capacity — enough room for two people and gear without excess bulk
• 3-season rating — handles spring, summer, and fall conditions well; not designed for winter camping or heavy snow loads
• 2.1 kg packed weight — manageable for multi-day carries without being ultralight
• Ripstop nylon construction — holds up to abrasion and light punctures on rocky ground

No discounts on this restock. Units are arriving in limited numbers and will be allocated on a first-come basis.

If the Ridgeline 2P fits your next trip, order while stock is available.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
